learningGoals: To understand and compare the length and height of different objects. 📏
To observe and guess which everyday objects are heavier or lighter. ⚖️
To learn the difference between thick and thin objects visually and by touch. 📚
To use measurement vocabulary confidently in daily conversations. 🗣️
teachingTips: Use family members to teach taller and shorter. Let your child compare their height with yours and other relatives! 🧍‍♂️👦
When sorting groceries, hand your child an onion and a pumpkin. Ask them to feel the weight and tell you which is heavier. 🛍️
Show them a thick storybook and a thin notebook to easily demonstrate the concept of thick versus thin. 📖
Encourage them to use these new words during playtime, like building the tallest block tower or finding the longest toy car. 🚗

funActivities.title: Family Line Up 👨‍👩‍👧
funActivities.description: Have everyone in the family (and even some stuffed animals!) stand in a line from shortest to tallest. Ask your child to point out who is the tallest. 📏

funActivities.title: The Balancing Act ⚖️
funActivities.description: Place an apple in one of your child's hands and a feather or leaf in the other. Ask them to pretend to be a weighing scale and dip the hand that is heavier! 🍎🍂

funActivities.title: Pencil Box Sorting ✏️
funActivities.description: Empty their pencil box and ask them to arrange all the pencils, erasers, and crayons on the table from the longest to the shortest. 🖍️
